tree.text: “position” means a civilian position in the Commission, or in any other agency if a substantial portion of the duties and responsibilities are performed in the Republic of Panama; and
“employee” means an individual serving in a position.

L. 104–201, § 3529. See below. Pub. L. 104–201, § 3529, amended subpar. (B) generally. Prior to amendment, subpar.
